posts.text:
🚀 For 13 flights, Starship was intentionally kept on a suborbital path. Flight 14 changed that.

On September 28, Ship 41 reached orbit for the first time, despite an early Raptor engine shutdown. SpaceX then used another engine burn to complete orbital insertion.

At roughly 275 km above Earth, Starship deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites—its first operational payload in orbit.

The flight ended early, but the milestone was enormous.

Starship didn’t just reach space. It finally entered the orbital era. 🌍🔥

posts.author: elonmusk
posts.text:
🚨 JUST NOW: Elon Musk and Jensen Huang give an INSIDE LOOK at the big meeting between top AI firms and President Trump today, saying they'll now be "grading each other's homework" 😆

@elonmusk: "We signed a JOINT DECLARATION regarding SI safety, and I think that'll be published by the White House soon."

"We agreed to a number of things that include a joint monitoring board, special committees, and just generally grading each other's homework, which is a LOT better than if people just grade their OWN homework, for obvious reasons." 😂

NVIDIA CEO @JensenHuang: "I thought the declaration has a LOT of teeth. I thought it was REALLY well written."

"It includes everything from rigorous internal controls, well established methods, well established processes, very clearly documented intentions of the products that you're building, internal controls to make sure that you're delivering on those intentions, internal audit that escalates, external audits from a third party, and then industry sharing best practices."

"POTUS pulled it all together. He watched over the meeting, and was able to bring EVERYBODY out."

posts.author: elonmusk
posts.text: I think it's a significant positive step that the leaders of every major American lab have committed to implementing robust internal controls and multiple layers of audits and reviews. This should give people more confidence that the technology each lab is building will work as intended.

quote.author: DavidSacks
quote.name: David Sacks
quote.text: Only President Trump could convene all the leaders of the top companies developing chips, data centers and frontier models for Super Intelligence. This new Industrial Revolution has already created a million new jobs and is spurring a bigger infrastructure build-out than the railroads, canals and grid combined. I was honored to witness history as the leaders of the frontier lab companies signed the White House Accord on Super Intelligence, accepting responsibility for the safe development of their products and imposing new internal controls and external audits. This is far better than waiting years for some international agreement that would probably never happen. President Trump continues to ensure that U.S. remains the technology leader while putting Americans first.
